summary: Practise model versioning, CI/CD, deployment, drift response, and handoff. Explore this MLOps training course and its applied curriculum.
lede: MLOps training helps data scientists, machine learning engineers, and DevOps practitioners move models from experimentation into production through repeatable release and operating workflows. Participants practise tracking model versions with Git and MLflow, packaging inference services with Docker, mapping CI/CD checks, and planning deployment controls, rollback, and drift monitoring. The course also covers retraining triggers and operational handoffs; Kubernetes orchestration is introduced conceptually rather than implemented.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who build, deploy, monitor, or govern machine learning services and need a clearer operating handoff from experimentation to production.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of machine learning model development and basic command-line or Git workflows is expected. Python code reading and light editing are required for the practical exercises; advanced software engineering experience is not required. Bring a laptop capable of running Python, Git, and Docker, or an equivalent prepared environment.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
